header.title: About Me
header.description: I'm a software developer based in Switzerland, focused on web development and design. Most of my day-to-day work is in JavaScript, React, and TypeScript. Right now I'm at Synprovis, helping build Improve 2 - a quality management software teams use in production.

items.title: Creative Foundations
items.description: My path started at Invers art school, where I learned design fundamentals. That’s where I first picked up web development and programming, and realized I wanted to build things people actually use.

items.title: First Steps as a Developer
items.description: I moved toward software development and shipped small projects on my own: real code, real constraints, and steady practice in JavaScript and the modern frontend stack.

items.title: Coding for Quality
items.description: Two years into that pivot, I joined Synprovis full time. I work on quality-management software day to day and help grow Improve 2, shipping TypeScript and React in a product environment.

end.title: Ready to Collaborate?
end.description: If you need to build a project with React, TypeScript, or JavaScript, let's work together to bring your idea to life.
